nav.privacyShort: Everything stays on this device only.

transcriber.title: Transcriber
transcriber.subtitle: Caption a live conversation or transcribe a file.
transcriber.hintIdle: Point the microphone at whoever is speaking. Text shows up here within seconds.
transcriber.meterHint: The bars move when the microphone picks up sound.
transcriber.meterFrozen: The bars are still because you asked for less motion. Use the label above.
transcriber.dropHint: Or drag a file here. Accepts MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG and video with audio.

transcriptions.title: Transcripts
transcriptions.subtitle: Everything you saved stays here, on your device.
transcriptions.emptyHint: After captioning or transcribing, tap Save.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Keep audio here to transcribe whenever you want.
library.dropHint: Or drag files here. They stay saved on your device.
library.emptyHint: Add audio to transcribe later, without hunting for it again.
library.noneQueued: No files waiting in the queue.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, reading and appearance.
settings.audioLanguageHint: The language spoken in recordings. Getting this right improves transcription a lot.
settings.regionHint: Sets the date, time and number format.
settings.textSizeHint: Applies to the text you read during a conversation. Minimum 18 px.
settings.textSizeSample: This is how the text will look to you.
settings.themeHint: Dark gives more contrast; light is for sunlight on the screen.
settings.privacyText: Your transcripts and files stay on this device only. The server receives the audio, transcribes it and keeps nothing.
settings.clearDataConfirm: This erases every transcript and file saved on this device. It cannot be undone.

errors.backendDownHint: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again in a moment.
errors.noKeyHint: The transcription service isn't set up on this server. You can still browse the app, but nothing will be transcribed.
errors.micDenied: We need microphone permission to caption. Allow access and try again.
errors.fileOpenFailed: We could not open that audio file. Try MP3, WAV, M4A or OGG.
